therapy.title:
An interior that

begins with you.
therapy.description: Therapeutic design builds on Premium Plus with an exploration of your needs, habits and sensory preferences. Light, materials and daily routines come together in a personal space of comfort.
therapy.note: No claims of medical or therapeutic effects.

consultations.title: Shall we start with a conversation?

workProcess.title:
Considered.

Discussed.

Brought to life.
workProcess.description:
You know what is happening

at every step — and what comes next.
workProcess.fineprint: Stages depend on the chosen package. Site visits, design supervision and procurement are agreed separately; in-person support is not guaranteed for international clients.

sketch.name: Initial design
sketch.do: Discuss the agreement and your goals, gather information, and complete the questionnaire and design brief.
sketch.get: A concept booklet, measured floor plan and furniture layout.

visual.name: Visual approval
visual.do: Agree on materials, palette, lighting and the overall character of the space.
visual.get: Mood boards or 3D visualization, depending on your package.

documents.name: Drawings and documentation
documents.do: Translate the approved design into detailed materials for implementation.
documents.get: Drawings and elevations within the scope of your package.

supervision.name: Design supervision
supervision.do: Discuss the available support format and review design decisions during implementation.
supervision.get: Implementation feedback within the agreed scope. Site visits are not available in every region.

procurement.name: Procurement
procurement.do: Select and agree on furniture, materials, textiles and other elements.
procurement.get: Selections and specifications within the agreed scope. Availability and prices are checked separately.
